title: Famous brands and the company that owns them

source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?parentLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item ?sitelinks (SAMPLE(?h) AS ?parent) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?h) AS ?n) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q431289 ; wdt:P127|wdt:P749 ?h ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . ?h wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q4830453 . FILTER(?sitelinks > 40) FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item wdt:P576 ?end } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q786820 } } GROUP BY ?item ?sitelinks ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 300 } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . FILTER(?n = 1) OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 160

parent.match: Match each brand to the company that owns it.
parent.odd: Three of these brands are owned by {value}. Which one isn't?

exclude.why: Kit Kat: Nestlé makes it worldwide but Hershey makes it in the US - the answer depends on the country

rows.label: Xbox
rows.description: Microsoft's video gaming brand
rows.hook: is a game console line with a glowing green button, home to the Master Chief shooter series

rows.label: PlayStation
rows.description: video gaming brand owned by Sony Interactive Entertainment
rows.hook: is a game console line whose controller has triangle, circle, cross and square buttons

rows.label: KFC
rows.description: American fast food restaurant chain specializing in fried chicken
rows.hook: sells fried chicken and is fronted by a white-suited colonel with glasses and a goatee

rows.label: Barbie
rows.description: fashion doll brand and media franchise
rows.hook: is a fashion doll with a long-time boyfriend named Ken and a hit pink movie

rows.label: Taco Bell
rows.description: American fast-food chain
rows.hook: is a fast-food chain that sells Crunchwraps and Chalupas and once ran ads with a talking chihuahua

rows.label: Uniqlo
rows.description: Japanese casual wear designer, manufacturer and retailer
rows.hook: is a casual-clothing retailer known for cheap thermal underwear and ultralight down jackets

rows.label: Pizza Hut
rows.description: American restaurant chain and international franchise
rows.hook: is a restaurant chain known for red roofs and stuffed-crust pies

rows.label: Converse
rows.description: American shoe company and brand
rows.hook: makes canvas high-top sneakers known as Chuck Taylors

rows.label: M&M's
rows.description: brand of chocolate candy pieces
rows.hook: makes candy-coated chocolates that melt in your mouth, not in your hand

rows.label: Dunkin'
rows.description: American global donut company and coffeehouse
rows.hook: is a doughnut and iced-coffee chain that began in Massachusetts and has a pink and orange logo

rows.label: Vogue
rows.description: American fashion and lifestyle magazine
rows.hook: is a glossy fashion magazine whose cover is a coveted honor, long led by editor Anna Wintour

rows.label: Zara
rows.description: retailer for clothing and perfumes, headquartered in Spain
rows.hook: is a fast-fashion retailer that turns runway trends into store clothes within weeks

rows.label: Pringles
rows.description: brand of potato-based chips
rows.hook: sells stackable saddle-shaped chips packed in a tall tube can

rows.label: Vespa
rows.description: Italian scooter
rows.hook: is a curvy scooter that Audrey Hepburn rode through Rome in a classic film

rows.label: Nutella
rows.description: chocolate hazelnut spread manufactured by Ferrero
rows.hook: is a chocolate hazelnut spread eaten on toast and crepes straight from the jar

rows.label: Toblerone
rows.description: brand of chocolate confection
rows.hook: is a chocolate bar shaped like a row of triangular peaks, made with honey and almond nougat

rows.label: Johnnie Walker
rows.description: brand of Scotch whisky owned by Diageo that originated in Kilmarnock, Ayrshire, Scotland
rows.hook: is a Scotch whisky sold as Red Label and Black Label with a striding man on the bottle

rows.label: Snickers
rows.description: brand name chocolate bar made by Mars, Incorporated

rows.label: Ray-Ban
rows.description: brand of luxury sunglasses and eyeglasses

rows.label: Kit Kat
rows.description: brand of chocolate products

rows.label: Cartier
rows.description: French jeweler

rows.label: Calvin Klein
rows.description: American fashion house
